providers.manifest:
{
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "id": "codex-usage",
  "displayName": "Codex Usage",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "minAppVersion": "1.1.0",
  "description": "ChatGPT/Codex 5h and weekly usage via remote provider script.",
  "runtime": "builtin-js",
  "entry": "provider.js",
  "requiredEnvVars": [],
  "output": "provider-snapshot-v1",
  "permissions": [
    "fs:~/.codex/auth.json",
    "fs:env:CODEX_AUTH_FILE",
    "env:CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN",
    "env:CODEX_ACCOUNT_ID",
    "env:CODEX_AUTH_FILE",
    "net:https://chatgpt.com"
  ],
  "defaultConfig": {
    "name": "Codex",
    "windowLabelOverrides": {
      "5h": "5小时限",
      "weekly": "周限"
    }
  },
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN",
      "label": "Codex access token",
      "kind": "secret",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "${secret:CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN}",
      "description": "Optional override. By default the provider reads the local Codex auth file.",
      "helpUrl": "https://help.openai.com/",
      "advanced": true
    },
    {
      "name": "CODEX_ACCOUNT_ID",
      "label": "ChatGPT account id",
      "kind": "string",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "${secret:CODEX_ACCOUNT_ID}",
      "description": "Optional account id override when the local Codex auth file is not enough.",
      "advanced": true
    },
    {
      "name": "CODEX_AUTH_FILE",
      "label": "Codex auth file",
      "kind": "string",
      "required": false,
      "placeholder": "C:\\Users\\you\\.codex\\auth.json",
      "description": "Optional path to a Codex auth.json file.",
      "advanced": true
    },
    {
      "name": "QBWIN_PROXY_URL",
      "label": "Provider proxy URL",
      "kind": "string",
      "required": false,
      "placeholder": "http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890",
      "description": "Optional runtime proxy for the Codex usage request. Prefer the provider Proxy URL setting; QuotaBarWin injects it as QBWIN_PROXY_URL.",
      "advanced": true
    }
  ],
  "checksums": {
    "source": "sha256:a8b98f7170a315c68ad1aee010242fa9d1debba3756bd6a5477cc359652e68a5"
  }
}

{
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "id": "deepseek-balance",
  "displayName": "DeepSeek Balance",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "minAppVersion": "1.1.0",
  "description": "DeepSeek pay-as-you-go account balance via remote provider script.",
  "runtime": "builtin-js",
  "entry": "provider.js",
  "requiredEnvVars": ["DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"],
  "output": "provider-snapshot-v1",
  "permissions": [
    "env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY",
    "env:DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_CURRENCY",
    "env:DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_REFERENCE_TOTAL",
    "env-prefix:DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_REFERENCE_TOTAL_",
    "env:DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_WARNING",
    "env-prefix:DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_WARNING_",
    "net:https://api.deepseek.com"
  ],
  "defaultConfig": {
    "name": "DeepSeek",
    "windowLabelOverrides": {
      "balance-cny": "余额（RMB）"
    },
    "envVars": {
      "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY": "${secret:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}",
      "DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_CURRENCY": "CNY",
      "DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_WARNING_CNY": "20",
      "DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_REFERENCE_TOTAL_CNY": "200"
    }
  },
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY",
      "label": "DeepSeek API Key",
      "kind": "secret",
      "required": true,
      "defaultValue": "${secret:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}",
      "description": "DeepSeek API token for reading account balance.",
      "helpUrl": "https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys"
    },
    {
      "name": "DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_CURRENCY",
      "label": "Currency",
      "kind": "string",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "CNY",
      "placeholder": "CNY",
      "description": "Optional currency filter. Leave empty to show every currency returned by the API.",
      "advanced": true
    },
    {
      "name": "DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_WARNING_CNY",
      "label": "CNY warning balance",
      "kind": "number",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "20",
      "description": "Shows a warning when the CNY balance is at or below this amount.",
      "advanced": true
    },
    {
      "name": "DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_REFERENCE_TOTAL_CNY",
      "label": "CNY reference total",
      "kind": "number",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "200",
      "description": "Reference total used to render the balance progress bar.",
      "advanced": true
    }
  ],
  "checksums": {
    "source": "sha256:4dfb71cfad46ab43f633f659560f2ee9554df3ef4a366cd9f7bfe1fca35b02cc"
  }
}

{
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "id": "time-flies",
  "displayName": "光阴似箭 (Time Flies)",
  "version": "1.3.0",
  "minAppVersion": "1.1.0",
  "description": "Shows the minutes remaining today, this week, this month, and this year in the local timezone.",
  "runtime": "builtin-js",
  "entry": "provider.js",
  "requiredEnvVars": [],
  "output": "provider-snapshot-v1",
  "permissions": [],
  "defaultConfig": {
    "name": "光阴似箭",
    "notificationsEnabled": false,
    "visibleWindowIds": ["today", "week-monday", "week-sunday", "month", "year"],
    "windowLabelOverrides": {
      "today": "本日余时",
      "week-monday": "本周余时（周一开始）",
      "week-sunday": "本周余时（周日开始）",
      "month": "本月余时",
      "year": "本年余时"
    },
    "timeoutSeconds": 5
  },
  "checksums": {
    "source": "sha256:fabd59b71ba4158bddaf857f87962dec40e217af4a69755c3a6c96aa619e6199"
  }
}
